Bid Summary.value: This solicitation is an informal Request for Proposal (RFP) issued by the State of Maryland Treasurer's Office under reference number 00004079359 and BPM044557 for Dell Laptops with Extended Warranty. The procurement is conducted as a secondary competition Purchase Order Request for Proposal (PORFP) and is limited strictly to Master Contractors awarded under the Desktop Laptop and Tablet 2015 Master Contract (060B5400007). Additionally, it is designated as a Small Business Reserve (SBR) procurement where award is limited to certified small business vendors meeting statutory requirements set forth in the Annotated Code of Maryland.
